sloka: यतस्व मुनि शार्दूल इति उक्त्वा त्रिदिवम् गतः ।विप्रस्थितेषु देवेषु विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ॥१-६३-२२॥
transliteration: yatasva muni śārdūla iti uktvā tridivam gataḥ ।viprasthiteṣu deveṣu viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ॥1-63-22॥

translations.english: Then Brahma said to him, 'You have not conquered the senses yet. O Tiger among ascetics, strive still.' Having said this he went toward heaven.
